paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Clarify Distinction -> Explain Why Naive Stacking Fails -> Highlight Core Coupling Mechanism -> Prove with 'Naive A+B' Ablation Data. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L016.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: We appreciate the opportunity to clarify how our architecture differs fundamentally from a naive combination of spectral filtering and neural ODEs. Directly stacking an FFT block with a standard neural ODE fails under abrupt regime shifts because spectral normalization strips the exact boundary values required to initialize the ODE trajectory. Our core technical innovation lies in the bidirectional phase-scale coupling operator (Eq. 7), which uses instantaneous spectral entropy to gate ODE stiffness while feeding predicted scale bounds back to regularize frequency attention. To verify this empirically, we implemented a direct `Naive FFT + ODE` concatenation baseline in Table R2 below: our coupled formulation reduces 720-step MSE by 15.2% over `Naive FFT + ODE`, confirming that the gain stems from our mathematical coupling rather than module stacking.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 超参数敏感性与极端噪声鲁棒性分析段（Sensitivity & Robustness Analysis）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想回应审稿人最常问的：你的模型是不是对超参数很敏感？在缺失值或传感器强噪声下会不会突然崩盘？

paragraphs.paragraph_en: Figure 4 evaluates hyperparameter sensitivity and resilience against severe observation corruption. Varying the phase regularization weight $\lambda$ across $[0.05, 0.50]$ alters validation MSE by less than 1.4%, indicating a wide, tuning-friendly operating plateau around $\lambda=0.15$. Under stress tests where 30% of sensor readings are randomly masked or corrupted by impulse noise ($\text{SNR} = 5\text{ dB}$), point-wise Transformer baselines suffer a 34.2% error surge, whereas DyTS-Net degrades by only 4.8%. This robustness stems from our spectral energy gate, which automatically attenuates high-entropy corrupted channels prior to cross-variate message passing.

paragraphs.paragraph_en: Figure 5 visualizes 336-step forecasts during an abrupt voltage drop on the ETTm1 transformer load benchmark. Whereas PatchTST and iTransformer exhibit a 14-step phase lag and severe post-recovery overshoot, DyTS-Net tracks both the sharp downward ramp and subsequent stabilization within 5% amplitude error. Nevertheless, the failure case in Panel (d) reveals that when an unscheduled manual grid curtailment occurs without preceding spectral precursors, our endogenous model experiences a 6-step delayed response. Anticipating such zero-precursor manual interventions requires integrating exogenous dispatch logs alongside historical telemetry.

paragraphs.section_or_role_zh: 计算开销、推理延迟与精度帕累托权衡段（Efficiency-Accuracy Pareto Analysis）
paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想说明我们的模型不仅准，而且算得快、显存省，在“精度-延迟/显存”帕累托前沿（Pareto Frontier）上显著优于现有大模型。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Hardware Benchmark -> Complexity Reduction & Memory Gain -> Real-Time Latency Margin -> Pareto Conclusion. 绑定逻辑规则：L010, L023.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Figure 6 plots the MSE-latency Pareto frontier measured on an onboard NVIDIA Orin AGX module. By replacing $O(L^2)$ point-wise self-attention with $O(L \log L)$ spectral filtering and compact patch tokens, DyTS-Net reduces peak GPU memory by 62% and training wall-clock time by 3.4x compared with iTransformer. At inference time, generating a 16-step visuomotor trajectory requires only 6.8 ms—well below the 20 ms cycle budget of a 50 Hz industrial robot controller—while outperforming a 200 ms DDPM baseline by 11.4% in task success rate.

paragraphs.paragraph_intent_zh: 我这一段想写论文末尾或 NeurIPS/ICLR Checklist 要求的 Limitations 段落：诚实指出当前方法的两个客观边界，但绝不贬损论文的核心贡献。
paragraphs.cohesion_formula: Two Objective Boundaries -> [Boundary 1 + Technical Remedy] -> [Boundary 2 + Stochastic Extension]. 绑定逻辑规则：L017.
paragraphs.paragraph_en: Despite its strong empirical performance, our framework exhibits two theoretical boundaries worth noting. First, while our spectral branch scales quasi-linearly with sequence length, computing pairwise Hilbert phase differences scales quadratically with channel count ($O(C^2)$), which increases memory footprint when $C > 2,000$; incorporating anchor-based low-rank graph sparsification provides a direct remedy. Second, our continuous neural-ODE scale tracker assumes piece-wise smooth drift and may smooth over instantaneous step discontinuities caused by sensor recalibration. Extending the continuous drift prior to jump-diffusion stochastic differential equations offers a principled direction for future investigation.
